summary: Industrial Logistics Properties Trust filed an 8-K regarding its consolidated joint venture, Mountain JV, entering into a $1.62 billion mortgage loan agreement with a syndicate of lenders led by Wells Fargo, Citi, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Bank of Montreal, and UBS. The loan is secured by 90 properties, matures in May 2031, and bears a fixed rate of 5.71%. Proceeds were used to repay $1.6 billion of existing floating-rate and fixed-rate mortgage debt, terminating the floating-rate loan without penalty. The registrant issued a customary limited recourse guaranty. This is a routine refinancing; no special-situation event.
